$Comment: Christmas Eve's celebration, the moment a player collects Christmas Eve's pay: a big banner with a
fanfare for them and for everyone within RadiusBlocks of them (everyone round Santa's tree), and a
firework over their head. The loot table Christmas_Eve_Pay names this moment with the Cue on its first
roll, and only Christmas Eve pays that table, so it plays once a year per player.
Reword the banner with the keys notify.christmas_eve_delivered and its .sub line in
christmas.world.lang; the sub line's {0} is the player's name. SoundEventId is any SoundEvent id, heard
by each player shown the banner. Command runs as the console with {player} filled in: the game's own
particle spawn command, at that player, with any ParticleSystem id. Delete Command for no firework.
